items.question: Trong câu "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", từ "describe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", what does "describe" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to say what something is like
items.explanation: describe /dɪˈskraɪb/ (động từ): mô tả. "Describe a requirement" = mô tả một yêu cầu; danh từ: description (bản mô tả).
items.explanationEn: describe /dɪˈskraɪb/ (verb): to say what something is like. "Describe a requirement" means explaining what is needed; noun: description.

items.question: Trong câu "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", từ "requirement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", what does "requirement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪəmənt/ (danh từ): yêu cầu (điều cần có). "Software requirement" = yêu cầu phần mềm; động từ gốc: require (đòi hỏi).
items.explanationEn: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪəmənt/ (noun): something that is needed. A "software requirement" is what the software must do; base verb: require.

items.question: Trong câu "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", từ "end user" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", what does "end user" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a person testing a trial version
a user who has stopped using it
the person who runs the system
the person who finally uses a product
items.explanation: end user /ˌend ˈjuːzə/ (cụm từ): người dùng cuối. "End user" là người thực sự dùng sản phẩm, khác với người xây dựng hay mua sản phẩm.
items.explanationEn: end user /ˌend ˈjuːzə/ (phrase): the person who finally uses a product. The "end user" is the person who actually uses the product, not the one who builds or buys it.

items.question: Trong câu "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", từ "point of view" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", what does "point of view" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a way of seeing a situation
a score given in a review
items.explanation: point of view /ˌpɔɪnt əv ˈvjuː/ (cụm từ): góc nhìn, quan điểm. "From the user's point of view" = từ góc nhìn của người dùng.
items.explanationEn: point of view /ˌpɔɪnt əv ˈvjuː/ (phrase): a way of seeing a situation. "From the user's point of view" means as the user sees it.

items.question: Trong câu "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", từ "natural" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", what does "natural" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: natural /ˈnætʃrəl/ (tính từ): tự nhiên (như người thường nói). "Natural language" = ngôn ngữ tự nhiên (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt...), không phải ngôn ngữ lập trình.
items.explanationEn: natural /ˈnætʃrəl/ (adjective): ordinary, as people normally speak. "Natural language" means human language such as English, not a programming language.

items.question: Trong câu "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", từ "focus on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", what does "focus on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: focus on /ˈfəʊkəs ɒn/ (cụm từ): tập trung vào. "Be focused on value" = tập trung vào giá trị; danh từ: focus (trọng tâm).
items.explanationEn: focus on /ˈfəʊkəs ɒn/ (phrase): to give most attention to. "Be focused on value" means value gets most of the attention; noun: focus.

items.question: Trong câu "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", từ "value" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", what does "value" (noun) mean?
options: giá trị, lợi ích mang lại
optionsEn: the data stored in a variable
items.explanation: value /ˈvæljuː/ (danh từ): giá trị, lợi ích mang lại. Trong User Story, "value" là lợi ích người dùng nhận được; tính từ: valuable (có giá trị).
items.explanationEn: value /ˈvæljuː/ (noun): the benefit something brings. In a user story, "value" is the benefit the user gets; adjective: valuable.

items.question: Trong câu "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", từ "rather than" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", what does "rather than" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rather than /ˈrɑːðə ðæn/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "Focus on value rather than a technical solution" = chú trọng giá trị thay vì giải pháp kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: rather than /ˈrɑːðə ðæn/ (phrase): instead of. "Value rather than a technical solution" means value is chosen instead of the solution.

items.question: Trong câu "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", từ "technical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", what does "technical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: technical /ˈteknɪkl/ (tính từ): thuộc về kỹ thuật. "Technical solution" = giải pháp kỹ thuật; "technical debt" = nợ kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: technical /ˈteknɪkl/ (adjective): relating to engineering skills. A "technical solution" is an engineering answer; compare "technical debt".

items.question: Trong câu "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", từ "solution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A User Story is a way of describing a software requirement from the end user's point of view, written in natural language, kept short, and focused on value rather than a technical solution.", what does "solution" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way of solving a problem
items.explanation: solution /səˈluːʃn/ (danh từ): giải pháp. "A technical solution" = một giải pháp kỹ thuật; động từ: solve (giải quyết).
items.explanationEn: solution /səˈluːʃn/ (noun): a way of solving a problem. "A technical solution" is a technical way to solve a problem; verb: solve.

items.question: Trong câu "Can this story be developed/tested on its own?", từ "develop" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can this story be developed/tested on its own?", what does "develop" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: develop /dɪˈveləp/ (động từ): phát triển, xây dựng. "Develop a feature" = phát triển một tính năng; danh từ: developer (lập trình viên).
items.explanationEn: develop /dɪˈveləp/ (verb): to build and create. "Develop a feature" means building it; noun: developer.

items.question: Trong câu "Can this story be developed/tested on its own?", từ "on its own" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can this story be developed/tested on its own?", what does "on its own" (phrase) mean?
options: tự nó, một cách độc lập
items.explanation: on its own /ɒn ɪts ˈəʊn/ (cụm từ): tự nó, một cách độc lập. "Tested on its own" = kiểm thử độc lập, không cần story khác.
items.explanationEn: on its own /ɒn ɪts ˈəʊn/ (phrase): by itself, independently. "Tested on its own" means tested without needing any other story.

items.question: Trong câu "If this feature didn't exist, would the user be affected?", từ "feature" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If this feature didn't exist, would the user be affected?", what does "feature" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feature /ˈfiːtʃə/ (danh từ): tính năng (của sản phẩm). "A new feature" = một tính năng mới; "feature request" = yêu cầu tính năng.
items.explanationEn: feature /ˈfiːtʃə/ (noun): a function of a product. "A new feature" is a new function; a "feature request" asks for one.

items.question: Trong câu "If this feature didn't exist, would the user be affected?", từ "exist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If this feature didn't exist, would the user be affected?", what does "exist" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exist /ɪɡˈzɪst/ (động từ): tồn tại. "If this feature didn't exist" = nếu tính năng này không tồn tại; tính từ: existing (hiện có).
items.explanationEn: exist /ɪɡˈzɪst/ (verb): to be real or present. "If this feature didn't exist" imagines it is not there; adjective: existing.

items.question: Trong câu "If this feature didn't exist, would the user be affected?", từ "affect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If this feature didn't exist, would the user be affected?", what does "affect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: affect /əˈfekt/ (động từ): ảnh hưởng, tác động đến. "Be affected" = bị ảnh hưởng; đừng nhầm với danh từ effect (kết quả, tác động).
items.explanationEn: affect /əˈfekt/ (verb): to have an influence on. "Be affected" means being influenced; do not confuse it with the noun effect.

items.question: Trong câu "Does the dev have enough information to estimate it?", từ "estimate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does the dev have enough information to estimate it?", what does "estimate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈestɪmeɪt/ (động từ): ước lượng. "Estimate the effort" = ước lượng công sức; danh từ: estimation (sự ước lượng).
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈestɪmeɪt/ (verb): to roughly calculate. "Estimate the effort" means guessing how much work it takes; noun: estimation.

items.question: Trong câu "Do we know when the story is considered "done"?", từ "consider" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do we know when the story is considered "done"?", what does "consider" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consider /kənˈsɪdə/ (động từ): coi là, xem như. "Be considered done" = được coi là hoàn thành.
items.explanationEn: consider /kənˈsɪdə/ (verb): to regard as. "Be considered done" means being regarded as finished.

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance Criteria are the specific conditions for a User Story to be considered complete.", từ "acceptance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance Criteria are the specific conditions for a User Story to be considered complete.", what does "acceptance" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the right to enter or use
a case that breaks a rule
items.explanation: acceptance /əkˈseptəns/ (danh từ): sự chấp nhận, nghiệm thu. "Acceptance Criteria" = tiêu chí nghiệm thu; động từ: accept (chấp nhận).
items.explanationEn: acceptance /əkˈseptəns/ (noun): approval that work is satisfactory. "Acceptance Criteria" are the rules for approving work; verb: accept.

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance Criteria are the specific conditions for a User Story to be considered complete.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance Criteria are the specific conditions for a User Story to be considered complete.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪəriən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số nhiều bất quy tắc: criterion → criteria (các tiêu chí).
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪəriən/ (noun): a standard for judging. It has an irregular plural: criterion → criteria.

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance Criteria are the specific conditions for a User Story to be considered complete.", từ "specific" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance Criteria are the specific conditions for a User Story to be considered complete.", what does "specific" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: specific /spəˈsɪfɪk/ (tính từ): cụ thể. "Specific conditions" = điều kiện cụ thể; trái nghĩa: general, vague.
items.explanationEn: specific /spəˈsɪfɪk/ (adjective): clearly defined, exact. "Specific conditions" are exact conditions; opposites: general, vague.

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance Criteria are the specific conditions for a User Story to be considered complete.", từ "condition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance Criteria are the specific conditions for a User Story to be considered complete.", what does "condition" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the physical state of an object
a thing that must be true
items.explanation: condition /kənˈdɪʃn/ (danh từ): điều kiện. "On condition that..." = với điều kiện là...; AC liệt kê các điều kiện phải đạt.
items.explanationEn: condition /kənˈdɪʃn/ (noun): a thing that must be true. "On condition that..." means only if...; AC list the conditions that must be met.

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance Criteria are the specific conditions for a User Story to be considered complete.", từ "complete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance Criteria are the specific conditions for a User Story to be considered complete.", what does "complete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: complete /kəmˈpliːt/ (tính từ): hoàn thành, xong. "Be considered complete" = được coi là đã hoàn thành; động từ cùng dạng: complete.
items.explanationEn: complete /kəmˈpliːt/ (adjective): finished. "Be considered complete" means regarded as finished; the verb has the same form.

items.question: Trong câu "The story describes a solution instead of a need", từ "instead of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The story describes a solution instead of a need", what does "instead of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "A instead of B" = chọn A thay cho B; ở đây story mô tả giải pháp thay vì nhu cầu.
items.explanationEn: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (phrase): in place of. "A instead of B" means A replaces B; here the story gives a solution in place of a need.

items.question: Trong câu "The AC misses edge cases", từ "edge case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The AC misses edge cases", what does "edge case" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: an unusual case at the limits
items.explanation: edge case /ˈedʒ keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp biên, hiếm gặp. "Handle edge cases" = xử lý các trường hợp biên như hết hàng, vượt giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: edge case /ˈedʒ keɪs/ (phrase): an unusual case at the limits. "Handle edge cases" means covering rare situations such as out-of-stock or over-limit.

items.question: Trong câu "The AC is vague", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The AC is vague", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không rõ ràng. "Vague requirements" = yêu cầu mơ hồ; trái nghĩa: specific, precise.
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): unclear, not precise. "Vague requirements" are unclear ones; opposites: specific, precise.

items.question: Trong câu "When a story is too big, it needs to be split.", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a story is too big, it needs to be split.", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): chia nhỏ, tách ra. Quá khứ và phân từ vẫn là split; "story splitting" = chia nhỏ story.
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into parts. Past and past participle are also split; "story splitting" means dividing stories.

items.question: Trong câu "Here are the common techniques:", từ "common" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here are the common techniques:", what does "common" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: common /ˈkɒmən/ (tính từ): phổ biến, thường gặp. "Common mistakes" = lỗi thường gặp; "in common" = có điểm chung.
items.explanationEn: common /ˈkɒmən/ (adjective): widely used, usual. "Common mistakes" are frequent ones; "in common" means shared.

items.question: Trong câu "Here are the common techniques:", từ "technique" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here are the common techniques:", what does "technique" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: technique /tekˈniːk/ (danh từ): kỹ thuật, phương pháp. "Splitting techniques" = các kỹ thuật chia nhỏ; khác với technology (công nghệ).
items.explanationEn: technique /tekˈniːk/ (noun): a particular way of doing. "Splitting techniques" are methods for splitting; compare technology.

items.question: Trong câu "The DoD is a list of conditions that apply to every story, without needing to be written into each one:", từ "apply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The DoD is a list of conditions that apply to every story, without needing to be written into each one:", what does "apply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (động từ): áp dụng cho. "Apply to" = áp dụng cho; "apply for a job" = nộp đơn xin việc.
items.explanationEn: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (verb): to be relevant to. "Apply to" means be relevant to; "apply for a job" means request one.

items.question: Trong câu "AC: conditions specific to each story — "when is this feature done?"", từ "specific to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AC: conditions specific to each story — "when is this feature done?"", what does "specific to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: specific to /spəˈsɪfɪk tuː/ (cụm từ): chỉ riêng cho. "Conditions specific to each story" = điều kiện riêng của từng story.
items.explanationEn: specific to /spəˈsɪfɪk tuː/ (phrase): belonging only to. "Conditions specific to each story" belong to that story only.

items.question: Trong câu "DoD: the team's shared conditions — "when is a story considered shipped?"", từ "shared" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DoD: the team's shared conditions — "when is a story considered shipped?"", what does "shared" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: held in common by a group
items.explanation: shared /ʃeəd/ (tính từ): chung, dùng chung. "Shared conditions" = điều kiện chung cho cả team; động từ: share (chia sẻ).
items.explanationEn: shared /ʃeəd/ (adjective): held in common by a group. "Shared conditions" apply to the whole team; verb: share.

items.question: Trong câu "DoD: the team's shared conditions — "when is a story considered shipped?"", từ "consider" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DoD: the team's shared conditions — "when is a story considered shipped?"", what does "consider" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consider /kənˈsɪdə/ (động từ): cân nhắc kỹ. "Be considered shipped" = được coi là đã phát hành.
items.explanationEn: consider /kənˈsɪdə/ (verb): to think carefully about. "Be considered shipped" means regarded as released.

items.question: Trong câu "DoD: the team's shared conditions — "when is a story considered shipped?"", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DoD: the team's shared conditions — "when is a story considered shipped?"", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): vận chuyển bằng tàu. Trong phần mềm, "ship a feature" = phát hành tính năng tới người dùng.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to carry goods by sea. In software, "ship a feature" means releasing it to users.

items.question: Trong câu "Story Points measure the complexity (not the time) of a story:", từ "measure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Story Points measure the complexity (not the time) of a story:", what does "measure" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to find the size or amount
items.explanation: measure /ˈmeʒə/ (động từ): đo lường. "Measure complexity" = đo độ phức tạp; danh từ: measurement (phép đo).
items.explanationEn: measure /ˈmeʒə/ (verb): to find the size or amount. "Measure complexity" means assessing how complex it is; noun: measurement.

items.question: Trong câu "Story Points measure the complexity (not the time) of a story:", từ "complexity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Story Points measure the complexity (not the time) of a story:", what does "complexity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: complexity /kəmˈpleksəti/ (danh từ): độ phức tạp. Tính từ: complex (phức tạp); story point đo độ phức tạp chứ không đo thời gian.
items.explanationEn: complexity /kəmˈpleksəti/ (noun): how complicated something is. Adjective: complex; story points measure complexity, not time.

items.question: Trong câu "Add validation to a form", từ "validation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Add validation to a form", what does "validation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: validation /ˌvælɪˈdeɪʃn/ (danh từ): kiểm tra tính hợp lệ. "Form validation" = kiểm tra dữ liệu nhập vào form; động từ: validate.
items.explanationEn: validation /ˌvælɪˈdeɪʃn/ (noun): checking that input is valid. "Form validation" checks the data typed into a form; verb: validate.

items.question: Trong câu "Integrate a payment gateway", từ "integrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Integrate a payment gateway", what does "integrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: integrate /ˈɪntɪɡreɪt/ (động từ): tích hợp. "Integrate A with/into B" = tích hợp A vào B; danh từ: integration.
items.explanationEn: integrate /ˈɪntɪɡreɪt/ (verb): to combine into a system. "Integrate A with/into B" means connecting A into B; noun: integration.

items.question: Trong câu "The team estimates simultaneously (without being influenced by others)", từ "simultaneously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team estimates simultaneously (without being influenced by others)", what does "simultaneously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: simultaneously /ˌsɪmlˈteɪniəsli/ (trạng từ): đồng thời, cùng lúc. Trong Planning Poker, mọi người lật bài đồng thời để không ảnh hưởng nhau.
items.explanationEn: simultaneously /ˌsɪmlˈteɪniəsli/ (adverb): at the same time. In Planning Poker everyone reveals cards at the same time to avoid bias.

items.question: Trong câu "The team estimates simultaneously (without being influenced by others)", từ "influence" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team estimates simultaneously (without being influenced by others)", what does "influence" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: influence /ˈɪnfluəns/ (động từ): ảnh hưởng, tác động. "Be influenced by others" = bị người khác tác động; cũng là danh từ: influence.
items.explanationEn: influence /ˈɪnfluəns/ (verb): to have an effect on. "Be influenced by others" means others affect you; it is also a noun.

items.question: Trong câu "If there is a large discrepancy → discuss to understand the story better", từ "discrepancy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If there is a large discrepancy → discuss to understand the story better", what does "discrepancy" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a difference that should not exist
items.explanation: discrepancy /dɪˈskrepənsi/ (danh từ): sự chênh lệch, không khớp. "A large discrepancy" = chênh lệch lớn giữa các ước lượng.
items.explanationEn: discrepancy /dɪˈskrepənsi/ (noun): a difference that should not exist. "A large discrepancy" is a big gap between estimates.

items.question: Trong câu "If there is a large discrepancy → discuss to understand the story better", từ "discuss" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If there is a large discrepancy → discuss to understand the story better", what does "discuss" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discuss /dɪˈskʌs/ (động từ): thảo luận. "Discuss something" không có "about" (không nói discuss about); danh từ: discussion.
items.explanationEn: discuss /dɪˈskʌs/ (verb): to talk about. "Discuss something" takes no "about"; noun: discussion.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA needs to provide enough information for the team to estimate accurately", từ "provide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA needs to provide enough information for the team to estimate accurately", what does "provide" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: provide /prəˈvaɪd/ (động từ): cung cấp. "Provide information for/to someone" = cung cấp thông tin cho ai.
items.explanationEn: provide /prəˈvaɪd/ (verb): to give or supply. "Provide information for/to someone" means giving it to them.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA needs to provide enough information for the team to estimate accurately", từ "accurately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA needs to provide enough information for the team to estimate accurately", what does "accurately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: accurately /ˈækjərətli/ (trạng từ): chính xác. "Estimate accurately" = ước lượng chính xác; tính từ: accurate.
items.explanationEn: accurately /ˈækjərətli/ (adverb): correctly and exactly. "Estimate accurately" means without errors; adjective: accurate.

items.question: Trong câu "A large story point count often means = unclear AC → needs refinement", từ "refinement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A large story point count often means = unclear AC → needs refinement", what does "refinement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: refinement /rɪˈfaɪnmənt/ (danh từ): sự làm rõ, tinh chỉnh. "Backlog refinement" = buổi làm rõ, chi tiết hóa backlog; động từ: refine.
items.explanationEn: refinement /rɪˈfaɪnmənt/ (noun): improving by clarifying details. "Backlog refinement" means clarifying backlog items; verb: refine.

items.question: Trong câu "A Story Map helps you see the whole user journey and prioritize the MVP:", từ "journey" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Story Map helps you see the whole user journey and prioritize the MVP:", what does "journey" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the steps a user goes through
items.explanation: journey /ˈdʒɜːni/ (danh từ): hành trình (các bước trải nghiệm). "User journey" = hành trình người dùng, từ tìm sản phẩm tới theo dõi đơn.
items.explanationEn: journey /ˈdʒɜːni/ (noun): the steps a user goes through. The "user journey" covers every step from browsing to tracking an order.

items.question: Trong câu "A Story Map helps you see the whole user journey and prioritize the MVP:", từ "prioritize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Story Map helps you see the whole user journey and prioritize the MVP:", what does "prioritize" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put in order of importance
items.explanation: prioritize /praɪˈɒrətaɪz/ (động từ): ưu tiên. "Prioritize the MVP" = ưu tiên phần MVP; danh từ: priority (sự ưu tiên).
items.explanationEn: prioritize /praɪˈɒrətaɪz/ (verb): to put in order of importance. "Prioritize the MVP" means doing it first; noun: priority.

items.question: Trong câu "An internal project management system.", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An internal project management system.", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɜːnl/ (tính từ): nội bộ. "Internal system" = hệ thống nội bộ; trái nghĩa: external.
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɜːnl/ (adjective): used inside an organization. An "internal system" is used only inside a company; opposite: external.

items.question: Trong câu "Does not include reminders for other people's tasks (that is in scope for the manager view)", từ "include" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does not include reminders for other people's tasks (that is in scope for the manager view)", what does "include" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: include /ɪnˈkluːd/ (động từ): bao gồm. "Does not include X" = không bao gồm X; trái nghĩa: exclude.
items.explanationEn: include /ɪnˈkluːd/ (verb): to contain as a part. "Does not include X" means X is not part of it; opposite: exclude.

items.question: Trong câu "Does not include reminders for other people's tasks (that is in scope for the manager view)", từ "reminder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does not include reminders for other people's tasks (that is in scope for the manager view)", what does "reminder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a message that helps you remember
items.explanation: reminder /rɪˈmaɪndə/ (danh từ): lời nhắc nhở. "Send a reminder" = gửi lời nhắc; động từ: remind (nhắc nhở).
items.explanationEn: reminder /rɪˈmaɪndə/ (noun): a message that helps you remember. "Send a reminder" means sending a prompt; verb: remind.

items.question: Trong câu "Does not include reminders for other people's tasks (that is in scope for the manager view)", từ "in scope" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does not include reminders for other people's tasks (that is in scope for the manager view)", what does "in scope" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in scope /ɪn ˈskəʊp/ (cụm từ): nằm trong phạm vi. "In scope" = thuộc phạm vi dự án; "out of scope" = nằm ngoài phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: in scope /ɪn ˈskəʊp/ (phrase): inside the agreed limits. "In scope" means part of the project's work; "out of scope" means not included.

items.question: Trong câu "No SMS notifications in this sprint", từ "notification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No SMS notifications in this sprint", what does "notification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notification /ˌnəʊtɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ (danh từ): thông báo. "Push notification" = thông báo đẩy; động từ: notify (thông báo).
items.explanationEn: notification /ˌnəʊtɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ (noun): a message that alerts you. A "push notification" is an alert on your device; verb: notify.
